an4.276:1.1: Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbā. Katame cattāro? Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, viriyasamādhi . . . pe . . . , cittasamādhi . . . pe . . . , {vīmaṃsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ} iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya ime cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbā. Rāgassa bhikkhave pariññāya
